official_definition: Tenma-Kagemusha - When your "Heavenly Demon King" family Spirit(s) are targeted by an opposing effect, you can summon this card from the Hand. Then, choose to either change the target of that effect to this Spirit only, or change the "opponent"/"opposing" text(s) of that effect to "you"/"your", and if it's the latter option, the opponent chooses the target.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Tenma-Kagemusha] or [Tenma-Kagemusha: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Tenma-Kagemusha]", "give [Tenma-Kagemusha]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
